+package r.base.random;
+
+public class SignRank {
+
+ public static double rsignrank(double n) {
+ int i, k;
+ double r;
+
+
+ /* NaNs propagated correctly */
+ if (Double.isNaN(n)) {
+ return (n);
+ }
+
+ n = Math.floor(n + 0.5);
+ if (n < 0) {
+ return Double.NaN;
+ }
+
+ if (n == 0) {
+ return (0);
+ }
+
+ r = 0.0;
+ k = (int) n;
+ for (i = 0; i < k;) {
+ r += (++i) * Math.floor(RNG.unif_rand() + 0.5);
+ }
+ return (r);
+
+ }
+}
